text:
maria (ml-eng): kicking off Harbor customer LoRA onboarding. quickpack shows localized decimal/thousand separator regressions, and a few trailing-zero drops. sharing minimal results and plan.
aj (applied-ml): are we using full graft or adapter-stitch? any LayerNorm grafts?
maria (ml-eng): adapter-stitch + full graft initially. eval command:
```
python eval_pack.py --model redwood-4x@harbor-lora-v1 --dataset harbor_invoice_qpack.json --metrics format_exact,amount_f1,latency_p50
```
initial results:
```
{"format_exact":"0.78","amount_f1":"0.95","latency_p50_ms":"76"}
```
sean (qa): 0.78 format_exact is a blocker for shipping. failing cases: thin-space (U+202F) removed, ".00" dropped, negative amounts placed incorrectly.
shadowbot: shadow-roll started: policy=3% route=prod-eu model=redwood-4x@harbor-lora-v1 run_id=sr-2026-04-05-003
nora (solutions): suggested mitigations: 1) graft only to MLP (avoid LN), 2) lower sparsity 0.7->0.5, 3) re-quantize per-channel symmetric int3, 4) add token-preserve postprocess as interim.
aj (applied-ml): also add tokenizer roundtrip checks and a locale-heavy quickpack (fr,de,es) to CI.
maria (ml-eng): building MLP-only sparse=0.5 artifact now. will run 1k quickpack + 1% shadow. uploading to s3 after build.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-04-05T18:00:00Z rollback_on=format_exact<0.95 or amount_f1<0.96
maria (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/harbor/redwood-4x-harbor-lora-mlp-s50-int3-pc.tar.gz sha256=fa12c3...
sean (qa): re-run results coming shortly; I'll add strict regex checks for two decimals and thousands separator preservation and will block if any fail.
aj (applied-ml): note to rollout doc: "graft=MLP-only, sparsity=50%, quant=per-channel int3 symmetric; token-preserve postprocess enabled for first 24h; monitor format_mismatch_rate and amount_f1."
maria (ml-eng): assigning 24h shadow monitoring to @nora. follow-ups opened for KV-cache warmstart and graft-layer ablation. :white_check_mark:
